description: An Imperial long plum outer coat over a cream linen tunic, with broad richly woven gold geometric borders at the front, cuffs and hem. A refined gold-patterned belt with small round clasps secures the waist and has a narrow ornamented hanging end. A plum shoulder drape fastens by a round gold red-stone brooch. Dark trousers and decorated dark leather shoes complete the high-noble outfit.
